answer: This is McCamish Pavilion, Georgia Tech’s basketball arena. It replaced the Alexander Memorial Coliseum, which previously occupied the site at 10th and Fowler Streets. The arena’s first men’s game was held on November 9, 2012, against Tulane. The renovation included a rectangular seating bowl and an upper deck.
